claims.evidence: No casing stamp, VIN tag, or import marking is visible or read in the photos.
No part number, casing engraving, or vehicle tag was read by the witness; only a generic transmission/bellhousing shape is shown.
No engine or displacement marking visible; witness only describes a generic automatic transmission assembly.

risks.risk: Unit may not be functional (no bench/road test shown)
risks.proof: Video of the transmission being spun by hand at the torque converter or a bench/engine test clip showing shift engagement
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/as-is, worst case non-functional

risks.risk: Fitment to a specific Ford Fusion engine/trim unconfirmed
risks.proof: Photo of stamped part/casting number or VIN tag on the case matched to a Fusion parts catalog
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified-fitment transmission, not guaranteed-fit

risks.proof: Photos/video of fluid on dipstick or drained fluid color and smell, plus any teardown or borescope images
Any accompanying paperwork, donor vehicle odometer photo, or yard inventory tag with history

risks.risk: Incomplete unit (missing sensors, mounts, bolts, connector pins)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all connector ends, mount brackets, and bolt holes compared to a full parts list
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially incomplete, deduct for missing parts

risks.risk: Hidden leaks or casing damage not visible from current angles
risks.proof: Photos of underside, pan, and all seal surfaces, plus a short video tilting the unit to check for fluid seepage

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any stamped part/casting number or VIN tag on the transmission case
Video of torque converter being rotated by hand or a bench test showing shift engagement
Photos of all electrical connectors and sensor ports to confirm completeness
Photo of fluid level/color via dipstick or drain plug
Any documentation of the donor vehicle (engine code, mileage) if available
Statement of warranty or return policy from seller
response.reason: The witness confirms a generic used automatic transmission assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified fitment, untested, unknown history) while the seller's specific Ford Fusion/4-cylinder/import claims remain unverifiable remotely.
